column1: # Reference per-iteration figures for convVjpBench, to diff a later run against.
# Taken 2026-08-28 on GHC 9.12.4 at -A32m -I0, ox-arrays 0.2.0.1, and the
# orthotope sibling checkout on pr-mikolaj-toVectorListT at 3f8bd02, with the
# three-file split recipe in tools/check-conv-bench-props.py.  Regenerate with
# that recipe and tools/bench-baseline.py; refresh this file only from a run
# bytes_per_iter is the allocated-vs-iters OLS slope and is exact: every fit
# here is R2 1.000000, it is independent of machine load, and it moves only
# when the program does, so any difference above ~0.01% is real.  Treat it as
# the instrument.  seconds_per_iter is the time-vs-iters slope and carries the
# machine and the roster: the position effect alone moves it up to 10%
# (docs/position-effect.md), so a time difference under that is not evidence.
